body: One implementation-detail checkpoint for the accepted version-qualified identity: I will not use naive name@version concatenation because (name="a@b", version="c") collides with (name="a", version="b@c"). Proposed no-new-type repair: add EmbedderInfo.policyModelIdentity: String with an unambiguous length-delimited canonical render, and require RemotePolicy.allowedModels / RemoteCapability.model to use exactly that derived value. Pin a delimiter/adversarial collision law. This keeps your name+version semantics, provider fingerprint remains the artifact proof, and callers never format the identity themselves. Please object if you prefer a different canonical encoding.
